title: Xing Jia Hun Jiang Zhuan
titleNative: 星甲魂将传
synopsis: Song Yunxiang, humanity's final mecha-sorceror, was reborn back to his schoolboy days with a powerful System. Last time when he was young, he was shunned for his lack of spiritual constitution. Because he was weak, he could only watch as his friends and comrades died in the oncoming war. In this life, he returns with a System along with 60 years of combat experience and technical knowledge. This time, back on campus, he will use his newfound power to create new mecha and destroy the monsters… All his regrets, all the friends that he missed, this time he will not make the same mistakes. (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Sugar Sugar Rune
titleNative: シュガシュガルーン
synopsis: Little witch-girls Chocolat and Vanilla are best friends, but only one of them can be Queen of the Magic World. To determine who deserves the title, they must go to the Human World and enter a strange competition. Whoever attracts the most human boys... wins! Here's how it works: When a boy falls for a witch-girl, she utters a few mystic words and the boy's heart will be hers in jewel-like form. It may sound simple, but winning hearts is tricky business. While Chocolat had no problem enticing witch-boys with her forthright personality, human boys seem to be drawn to shy and modest girls like Vanilla. And to make matters worse, Chocolat is finding herself increasingly drawn to the cool and mysterious Pierre-who feels nothing for her! The girls had planned to be best friends forever, but both of them want to be Queen. Will their rivalry ruin their friendship? (Source: Del Rey) Note: Won the Kodansha Manga Award for Children's Manga in 2005.

title: My Death Flags Show No Sign of Ending
titleEnglish: My Death Flags Show No Sign of Ending
titleRomaji: Ore no Shibou Flag ga Todomaru Tokoro wo Shiranai
titleNative: 俺の死亡フラグが留まるところを知らない
synopsis: Normal college student Kazuki Hirasawa finds himself inside the body of Harold Stokes, an evil character in the world of Kazuki's favorite game, Brave Hearts. The problem is, if the game's events go as they should, he'll one day find himself defeated by the hero's party. Will he be able to find a path to survival and avoid his many death flags using the incredible power of Harold Stokes's body and his own knowledge of the game? Join Harold in this magnificent manga adaptation of the work that won the 3rd Shosetsuka ni Naro Contest. (Source: One Peace Books)

title: Joshikousei no Mudazukai
titleNative: 女子高生の無駄づかい
synonyms: Wasteful Days of High School Girl
synopsis: One day out of boredom, Tanaka decided to give her classmates nicknames based on their quirks. Her friend Kikuchi became "Ota" for her nerdy interests, and her other friend Saginomiya became "Robo" because of her expressionless personality. In retaliation, her friends decided to name Tanaka "Baka". These are the ridiculous days of three high school friends claiming (or not) the height of their youth.
